import time


class TokenBucket:
    """Token bucket rate limiter: capacity tokens, refilled at rate per second."""

    def __init__(self, capacity, rate):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.rate = rate
        self.tokens = capacity
        self.updated = time.monotonic()

    def take(self, cost=1):
        now = time.monotonic()
        self.tokens = min(self.capacity, self.tokens + (now - self.updated) * self.rate)
        self.updated = now
        if self.tokens >= cost:
            self.tokens -= cost
            return True
        return False

def search_documents(index, query, limit=10):
    """Full-text search over documents, newest first."""
    hits = index.query(query)
    return sorted(hits, key=lambda h: h.created_at, reverse=True)[:limit]
